viewing_check: Unroll or lift a corner and check the back for moth damage, holes, repairs, dry rot, odd smells or stains. Measure it (280 x 155 cm claimed) and check the fringes and edges. Look at pile height, since a lot of the field looks worn. Photograph the back.
